limitations_zh: (1) 循环含人类在环：作者选择实现哪些提案、挑选后续 issue 并标注结果，并非自主闭环；实现由原始会话内 Claude Code 完成，且改动文件可能包含提案文本之外的信息。(2) 仅覆盖单一 agent 版本、单一 /retro 版本与环境类问题（测试命令、已知失败），导航与编码规范类适配未评测。(3) 每个 harness 仅 5 个会话、7 个 informative 事件，计数只描述这些个案，不能确立“覆盖性”为因果解释；评测 issue 是为复现目标问题而挑选的，可能高估实际收益。(4) 二元次结果（任务成功率、耗时）差异不一致，无法证明整体任务收益。(5) 首作者标注并非完全盲态。
原 v1 的“评估 12 个变更”未说明组成，容易把全部归于 retro。正文明确 11 个 resulting adaptations 加 1 个 author-written comparison；公开摘要删去聚合 12，保留作者另写对照的区分。

source_paragraphs.quote:
We first ran 30 coding-agent sessions and collected 125 proposals from /retro . We then coded the proposals, implemented 24 of them, and evaluated 11 resulting adaptations and one author-written comparison adaptation on later issues from the same repositories. All task sessions ran non-interactively using Claude Code 2.1.295 with Opus 5.5 and the same task prompt template, using /retro from source commit b0618bc [ 2 ] .
The artifact contains the prompts, codebook, labeling instructions, complete data, and the procedural details omitted below.

Eligibility and implementation. A proposal was eligible for implementation and evaluation on another issue if it was coded experience-driven , proposed a persistent harness change in permitted files and settings, including context files, hooks, and lint or continuous integration (CI) configuration, was safe to apply, did not merely fix the original issue, and admitted a written criterion for identifying repeated work in later sessions. The initial coding by Claude identified 33 eligible proposals, 14 from the exploratory sample and 19 from the second sample. The first author reviewed the exploratory-sample eligibility labels before implementation, and reviewed the second-sample labels only after implementation, where the two coders disagreed. From the second sample, we selected nine known-failures files and one test-command instruction, the two types for which other issues reproduced the targeted problem. Further SymPy proposals of these types were omitted as already evaluated in that repository, and for the remaining proposals we found no other issue reproducing the targeted problem. The original Claude Code sessions were resumed in their original containers to implement these 10 and all 14 exploratory-sample proposals. Eleven of the 24 implementations produced adaptations that we could evaluate on another issue. The other 13 changed no harness files, changed only the environment or files outside the permitted locations, or had no other issue reproducing the targeted problem. For comparison with these experience-driven adaptations, we also evaluated one pre-commit configuration from a proposal coded prior-driven . The configuration was written by the authors after Claude Code’s permission system blocked its implementation, giving 12 evaluated adaptations. The resolution of disagreements changed the eligibility of 16 proposals, none of them among the 12 evaluated adaptations.

mechanism_reasons_zh: 该文属于 harness_method。改进对象是执行器外部的可复用程序工件：Capability Builder 把执行中产生的解法固化为 MCP 工具（Python 模块，暴露 register(mcp)）与 skill blocks，Tracker 以非阻塞方式记录每次交互并按操作种类蒸馏，Researcher 在覆盖不足时研究失败任务并按进度分配尝试预算；这些都是系统提示/工具实现/skill 文件/控制流层面的 harness 工件，而非任务答案本身。反馈闭环明确：predictor（工具+skill 提出方案）—validator（仅用工具的确定性校验，编译/去重指纹/held-out 测量）—corrector（把校验发现回写修正 capability），并以尝试间改进量作为收敛判据。持久性明确：写入项目层随仓库提交，cold-start 产生的 store 被 warm-start 直接复用，recurring 任务首次尝试即解 93–95%，warm-start token 消耗显著低于一次基线尝试，证明工件跨任务/跨会话被保留并复用，而非仅修当前答案或在任务内重试。权重不是主要干预：三种模型经网关原样调用，两臂共用同一 harness 与同一模型，仅改变是否部署 Phronix，fine-tuning 仅作为背景对照。
limitations_zh: 证据边界：(1) 持久性证据限于 SWE-bench Lite 30 任务的 cold/warm 两轮协议与项目层提交，未测量长期多会话累积或跨机构复用；(2) 跨模型族迁移作者自述未测量，astropy 类任务首次尝试复用失败说明确定性有环境边界；(3) 追踪量按时间戳归属，作者自认该项读数只能作定性证据，知识计数不依赖该归属；(4) 部分结论基于单一 harness（Claude Code v2.1.246）与 low reasoning effort 设置，未报告对其他 harness 的实测；(5) 未提供权重是否被更新的显式声明，仅由实验设计推断权重非主要对象。

quote_checks.quote: Both arms of every comparison run on the Claude Code [ 1 ] harness (v2.1.246) at low reasoning effort, so extended reasoning does not become a second variable alongside Phronix.
Phronix operates through a predictor-validator-corrector loop: MCP tools and associated skills propose solutions, tool executions validate them, and observed outcomes refine the stored capabilities.
Phronix adds three components to an existing harness, one per concept, over a capability store whose three layers travel with the framework, the user, and the repository.

Writes default to the project layer, placing learning in the same commit and review as the code it describes, and a one-minute watcher registers capabilities appearing while the server runs, so a tool the learner writes becomes callable without a restart.

source_paragraphs.quote:
A task is solved when every FAIL_TO_PASS test of the official test patch passes and no PASS_TO_PASS test regresses, and the solve rate is the fraction of attempted tasks solved, pooled over runs.
The first-try rate is the fraction of tasks a cold-start run solved that a warm-start run then solved on its first attempt.
We further count the skills and MCP tools created and reused, the entries the tracker records, and the attempts and tokens a task consumes, including prompt-cache reads.
Every value is a mean over repeated runs, with error bars showing the sample standard deviation.

To show that capabilities are deterministic and intelligent, we confirm that Phronix builds an MCP tool together with skills for every kind of task, and that the result solves a recurring task without rediscovering its solution.
Our test runs the 30 tasks cold-start and then warm-start, so the second run begins from the store the first promoted.
We measure the skills and MCP tools a cold-start run builds, and the fraction of tasks a warm-start run solves on its first attempt among those previously solved by the cold-start run.
Figure 5 plots task category on the x axis with one bar per model, capabilities built per task on the left y axis split into skills and MCP tools, and that first-attempt rate on the right y axis as one line per model.

Every model builds both kinds in every category, gpt-5.4 building 7–9 capabilities per task against 19–34 for the other two, skills outnumbering MCP tools two to four times because the tool encodes what can be coded and the skills carry the judgment around it.
The warm-start lines confirm that these capabilities solve the task, at 94.8%, 93.5%, and 93.3% of previously solved tasks on the first attempt.
Four of five categories reach 95–100% with a standard deviation of at most 10 points, and Data & ML reaches 100% in every run of every model, which shows the solution is replayed rather than searched for again.
Scientific is the exception at 62–75% with the widest spread, because no model reproduces the two astropy tasks on its first attempt.
gpt-5.4 is as deterministic as the other two while building three to four times fewer capabilities per task, so determinism follows from the tool-and-skill pairing rather than the number of capabilities or the model.

source_quotes.quote:
During training, HSE periodically updates the external writer and evaluator rules that govern subsequent candidate construction and assessment.
Each update summarizes the task-evidence labels accumulated since the previous update together with the promotion outcomes observed during hierarchical aggregation.

HSE updates the writer rules to determine what evidence and actions may appear in subsequent candidates.
Candidate construction remains grounded in trace-visible evidence and respects the evidence requirements of the corresponding aggregation level.
For example, accumulated unresolved evidence makes subsequent candidate construction more conservative, shifting the writer toward recovery and validation rather than direct editing.
Conversely, successful promotions reinforce evidence patterns that have survived the preceding gates for reuse in subsequent candidates.
These updates shape how the writer constructs future candidates, while candidate promotion remains determined by the evaluator.

HSE evolves the evidence weights θ e \theta_{e} according to feedback accumulated after previous evaluation decisions, while keeping the decision thresholds τ revise \tau_{\mathrm{revise}} and τ accept \tau_{\mathrm{accept}} frozen.
When a promoted candidate is subsequently associated with regression, HSE increases the penalties assigned to the negative or risk signals that contributed to its promotion.
Conversely, when a revised or rejected candidate later accumulates consistent positive support, HSE increases the weights of the supporting signals that were previously undervalued.
Strong-positive and strong-negative evidence induces larger updates than weak evidence, reflecting the greater informativeness of their outcome transitions.

The resulting transfer package contains success skills, recovery skills, and the updated writer/evaluator rules.
The frozen coding agent receives the transferable skills, while the external controller receives the rules required to continue evolution in the next round.
New agent rollouts then provide L1 evidence for the next round, closing the loop in Figure 2 .

For target-benchmark adaptation, HSE starts from the transferred skill library and fixed writer/evaluator policies, and updates only the skill library using newly collected target-task trajectories.
Candidate updates are assessed by the learned evaluator without access to benchmark verifier outcomes or evaluation-time test results.

mechanism_reasons_zh: 本文属于 Harness METHOD。被改进的对象是外层优化器 agent 的“策略”制品，而非用户任务产物：包含系统提示模板、自然语言 playbook（可复用程序与经验）、可复用的优化器/诊断代码库（工具库/技能文件），以及决策节奏（工作流）。改进闭环由执行/评估反馈驱动：meta-agent 读取父策略与历史 run 的 digest（最终指标、z-score、agent 推理记录、最终优化器程序、笔记）以及 archive 中各任务分数与 changelog，据此改写子策略；子策略经校验后在训练套件上评测，结果连同证据存入 archive，性能引导后续父代采样与最终策略选择，并跨代继承（正文称 Later generations inherit and revise the procedures and tools accumulated by earlier ones）。持久性成立：演化得到的库与 playbook 被固定下来并用于后续 run，甚至在同一策略下换用 GPT-5.5 / GPT-6.1 做跨模型迁移时仍被沿用（Table 7 显示 82% 的 run 使用了演化库模块）。权重非主要干预：正文明确写明 The underlying LLM weights, meta-agent instructions, and evaluator remain fixed; the policy used to improve optimizers is the object that evolves，即模型权重、meta-agent 指令与评估器均冻结。需注意区分层级：单次 run 内被 agent 改写的 optimizer 程序属于任务输出，本文的 Harness 主张依赖于外层策略（提示+playbook+代码库+节奏）本身作为可复用执行程序被演化，这一点正文有明确表述与消融（-library、-playbook、-evolved prompt）支持，故纳入。
limitations_zh: 证据边界：(1) 演化套件仅 3 个任务、每策略 2 个种子，作者自陈 archive 选择可能偏向异常好的评测，泛化结论有限；(2) 缺少与“每次从 generation 0 独立提案”的匹配预算对照，也缺少 archive 与受限父代搜索的对照，因此“递归继承”的增益未被隔离；且 changelog 覆盖不完整（9/20 meta-agent 触及调用/时长上限）；(3) 迁移结果选择性明显：Opus 5.5 的 held-out 聚合分下降（+5.22 → +4.87），PDE 与 LSTM 上出现负向，作者明确不支持跨模型/跨域一致改进；(4) 组件消融显示 -library 的训练套件分反而略高（+14.45 vs +14.33），说明库的独立贡献未被干净分离，且 cadence 未被消融；(5) 存在一次 held-out 任务描述被 meta-agent 读取的事故，且 archive 摘要可造成间接信息传播，直接影响 held-out 结论的干净性；(6) PDE 与组合 held-out 的控制组聚合分因原始逐任务数据缺失而无法比较；(7) 规模限于单 GPU、短训练预算。

quote_checks.quote: a separate matched-budget control would be needed to isolate the benefit of inheritance over independent proposals

A separate meta-agent receives a copy of the parent policy and digests of its evaluation runs. Each digest contains the final metric and z-score, the in-run agent’s recorded rationales, final optimizer program, and notes.
RSI-Opt makes the agent’s accumulated knowledge an explicit, editable object: a prompt, a playbook of procedures and lessons, a library of optimizer and diagnostic code, and a decision cadence.

Every valid child is evaluated on the training suite and added to the archive, including children that score below their parent. Thus the archive retains explored alternatives, while performance guides further parent selection and the final policy choice.

quote_checks.quote: The readout is linear in eight coordinates of one projection per run, and the coefficients stay fixed through the 24 keep steps.

Each run fits one linear readout on the parent’s steering-split solve rate and eight coordinates of the proposed diff, from 96 scaffold edits labeled by four evaluations of a 16-instance fit split, and then freezes the coefficients.
The root is a scaffold: a system prompt and a loop that writes a solution, runs the unit tests, and retries once. A proposal is a unified diff of that scaffold.
The readout and the ablation keep the four evaluated nodes with the largest solve rate on that steering split.
A coding agent that rewrites its own scaffold has to choose which proposed edit to expand before that edit has been evaluated, and the search then has to return one agent.

mechanism_reasons_zh: 该工作把机器人 agent 的“harness”明确操作化为外部可复用程序产物：由指令 I、技能描述与可执行实现 S、请求构造/工具选择/反馈处理钩子 P、持久程序性知识 M、工具与能力绑定 D 组成的 Git 版本化包。外层元 agent（编码 agent）读取执行记录、定位失败决策、修改 harness 代码与协调逻辑，并通过主动诊断与全新自主 rollout 反复验证；宿主按成功率的比较规则决定候选是否替换现任，所有被接受（及被拒）版本与证据都持久保存在 harness DAG 中供后续迭代复用，属于典型“执行反馈驱动 + 跨轮次保留”的自我改进回路。权重层面作者明确声明“VISTA keeps the underlying model parameters fixed and optimizes how these resources are composed into autonomous behavior”，低层 VLA 与规划器权重、能力接口和评估规则均固定，因此被改进对象是可复用执行程序而非权重，符合 Harness 方法判定。
limitations_zh: 证据边界：全部实验在 LIBERO-Pro、RoboCasa365、RoboTwin 仿真中完成，作者自陈尚无真机验证；候选选择使用与开发相同的 dev 矩阵（M 个初始化 × R 次重复）作为形式评估，存在对该矩阵过拟合的可能，泛化到未见任务的证据主要来自 RoboCasa Composite Unseen 一项；元 agent 侧的具体提示/技能（evolve-harness skill）细节只在附录简述，未给出消融其各组成部分的完整实验。

quote_checks.quote: While VISTA demonstrates substantial gains across simulated benchmarks, our current evaluations are conducted strictly within high-fidelity simulation environments.

Given a base harness and these records, the meta-agent forms a concrete hypothesis and revises the implicated components, such as instructions, observation processing, skill termination, or coordination logic.
VISTA improves an embodied agent by evolving its harness, including the instructions, executable skills, and coordination logic through which the agent perceives, reasons, and acts.
All frozen versions and their available records are retained, regardless of promotion.

mechanism_reasons_zh: 该工作明确把外部可复用的执行程序（harness）作为被改进对象：语言模型权重固定，内层 ReAct 循环处理任务，外层循环在分层训练样本上评估失败轨迹并自主提出对 prompt、工具、memory、skill、middleware 等组件的修订；修订通过 anchor 与 memory 检查后被提交为部署 harness，否则回滚到 champion。被接受的 harness 会被冻结，并用同一未改动的 harness 在留出域测试集上评估，还迁移到另一个骨干模型（GPT-6 Luna）而无需再优化，说明修改后的工件可跨任务、跨会话、跨骨干持久复用。消融显示 prompt/tool/memory/skill/middleware 各组件的单独贡献，属于典型的 harness 演化方法而非权重优化，也不是单纯的经验存储/检索。
limitations_zh: 1) 实验只做了“a single round”自改进，多轮递归改进的持续增益未被验证；2) 训练面板与 anchor 仅 48 个任务，规模较小；3) 外层提议模型为 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash，改进提案本身依赖该模型，可能存在提议质量偏差；4) 迁移到 GPT 骨干时执行准确率略降，收益并非全部与骨干无关；5) 会议信息为占位符，工件/代码是否公开未在正文中说明；6) 评估基准 ODAC-Vis 为作者自建，外部独立复现证据不足。

source_paragraphs.quote:
We first ran 30 coding-agent sessions and collected 125 proposals from /retro . We then coded the proposals, implemented 24 of them, and evaluated 11 resulting adaptations and one author-written comparison adaptation on later issues from the same repositories. All task sessions ran non-interactively using Claude Code 2.1.295 with Opus 5.5 and the same task prompt template, using /retro from source commit b0618bc [ 2 ] .
The artifact contains the prompts, codebook, labeling instructions, complete data, and the procedural details omitted below.

Eligibility and implementation. A proposal was eligible for implementation and evaluation on another issue if it was coded experience-driven , proposed a persistent harness change in permitted files and settings, including context files, hooks, and lint or continuous integration (CI) configuration, was safe to apply, did not merely fix the original issue, and admitted a written criterion for identifying repeated work in later sessions. The initial coding by Claude identified 33 eligible proposals, 14 from the exploratory sample and 19 from the second sample. The first author reviewed the exploratory-sample eligibility labels before implementation, and reviewed the second-sample labels only after implementation, where the two coders disagreed. From the second sample, we selected nine known-failures files and one test-command instruction, the two types for which other issues reproduced the targeted problem. Further SymPy proposals of these types were omitted as already evaluated in that repository, and for the remaining proposals we found no other issue reproducing the targeted problem. The original Claude Code sessions were resumed in their original containers to implement these 10 and all 14 exploratory-sample proposals. Eleven of the 24 implementations produced adaptations that we could evaluate on another issue. The other 13 changed no harness files, changed only the environment or files outside the permitted locations, or had no other issue reproducing the targeted problem. For comparison with these experience-driven adaptations, we also evaluated one pre-commit configuration from a proposal coded prior-driven . The configuration was written by the authors after Claude Code’s permission system blocked its implementation, giving 12 evaluated adaptations. The resolution of disagreements changed the eligibility of 16 proposals, none of them among the 12 evaluated adaptations.

source_paragraphs.quote:
A task is solved when every FAIL_TO_PASS test of the official test patch passes and no PASS_TO_PASS test regresses, and the solve rate is the fraction of attempted tasks solved, pooled over runs.
The first-try rate is the fraction of tasks a cold-start run solved that a warm-start run then solved on its first attempt.
We further count the skills and MCP tools created and reused, the entries the tracker records, and the attempts and tokens a task consumes, including prompt-cache reads.
Every value is a mean over repeated runs, with error bars showing the sample standard deviation.

To show that capabilities are deterministic and intelligent, we confirm that Phronix builds an MCP tool together with skills for every kind of task, and that the result solves a recurring task without rediscovering its solution.
Our test runs the 30 tasks cold-start and then warm-start, so the second run begins from the store the first promoted.
We measure the skills and MCP tools a cold-start run builds, and the fraction of tasks a warm-start run solves on its first attempt among those previously solved by the cold-start run.
Figure 5 plots task category on the x axis with one bar per model, capabilities built per task on the left y axis split into skills and MCP tools, and that first-attempt rate on the right y axis as one line per model.

Every model builds both kinds in every category, gpt-5.4 building 7–9 capabilities per task against 19–34 for the other two, skills outnumbering MCP tools two to four times because the tool encodes what can be coded and the skills carry the judgment around it.
The warm-start lines confirm that these capabilities solve the task, at 94.8%, 93.5%, and 93.3% of previously solved tasks on the first attempt.
Four of five categories reach 95–100% with a standard deviation of at most 10 points, and Data & ML reaches 100% in every run of every model, which shows the solution is replayed rather than searched for again.
Scientific is the exception at 62–75% with the widest spread, because no model reproduces the two astropy tasks on its first attempt.
gpt-5.4 is as deterministic as the other two while building three to four times fewer capabilities per task, so determinism follows from the tool-and-skill pairing rather than the number of capabilities or the model.

after.summary_en: With the coding model frozen, HSE aggregates task, repository, and cross-repository evidence. Feedback evolves skills and also updates the external writer/evaluator rules and evidence weights, which are transferred to later rounds. Target-benchmark adaptation fixes those rules and updates only the skill library.

source_quotes.quote:
During training, HSE periodically updates the external writer and evaluator rules that govern subsequent candidate construction and assessment.
Each update summarizes the task-evidence labels accumulated since the previous update together with the promotion outcomes observed during hierarchical aggregation.

HSE updates the writer rules to determine what evidence and actions may appear in subsequent candidates.
Candidate construction remains grounded in trace-visible evidence and respects the evidence requirements of the corresponding aggregation level.
For example, accumulated unresolved evidence makes subsequent candidate construction more conservative, shifting the writer toward recovery and validation rather than direct editing.
Conversely, successful promotions reinforce evidence patterns that have survived the preceding gates for reuse in subsequent candidates.
These updates shape how the writer constructs future candidates, while candidate promotion remains determined by the evaluator.

HSE evolves the evidence weights θ e \theta_{e} according to feedback accumulated after previous evaluation decisions, while keeping the decision thresholds τ revise \tau_{\mathrm{revise}} and τ accept \tau_{\mathrm{accept}} frozen.
When a promoted candidate is subsequently associated with regression, HSE increases the penalties assigned to the negative or risk signals that contributed to its promotion.
Conversely, when a revised or rejected candidate later accumulates consistent positive support, HSE increases the weights of the supporting signals that were previously undervalued.
Strong-positive and strong-negative evidence induces larger updates than weak evidence, reflecting the greater informativeness of their outcome transitions.

The resulting transfer package contains success skills, recovery skills, and the updated writer/evaluator rules.
The frozen coding agent receives the transferable skills, while the external controller receives the rules required to continue evolution in the next round.
New agent rollouts then provide L1 evidence for the next round, closing the loop in Figure 2 .

For target-benchmark adaptation, HSE starts from the transferred skill library and fixed writer/evaluator policies, and updates only the skill library using newly collected target-task trajectories.
Candidate updates are assessed by the learned evaluator without access to benchmark verifier outcomes or evaluation-time test results.
